First, note that 12 AM is midnight (00:00) on December 24, 1280 in Europe/Athens.  
Time zone differences in 1280 are not defined by modern IANA rules, but historically Athens is about UTC+2 and US/Pacific is about UTC-8 in modern terms, giving a 10-hour difference (Athens ahead).  
Applying 10 hours behind: 00:00 - 10 hours = 14:00 previous day → December 23, 1280, 14:00 (2:00 PM).  

FINAL_ANSWER: December 23, 1280, 14:00
